ChildMinutesLst.Title: A. Panorama Presentation
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes:
A motion by Roady was seconded by Smith to accept the Assistant Superintendent of Accelerated Learning's recommendation to implement Panorama’s Surveys, Student Success, and Solara platforms at the annual cost of $50,010 per year beginning March 31, 2025 with the initial integration fee of $10,100 paid through the districts' partnership with Children’s Mercy. The balance of $47,410 for the first year of implementation will be paid with Title I funds.
The motion carried 6-0-0.
